facts.text: I bought a Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra today from Best Buy.
I bought a screen protector today from Best Buy.
I bought a case today from Best Buy.
I am trying to set up a wireless charging pad with my new phone.
I am thinking of getting a portable power bank to keep my phone charged on the go.
I already have an Anker wireless charging pad that has been working great.
I bought an Anker wireless charging pad recently.
I think I will stick with Anker for the portable power bank as well.
I like the idea of having a consistent Anker ecosystem.
I am considering the Anker PowerCore Fusion portable power bank.
I like that the Anker PowerCore Fusion has dual-input charging and dual-output charging.
I like that the Anker PowerCore Fusion supports Power Delivery for faster charging.
I am considering getting Sony WF-1000XM4 wireless earbuds.
I want to make sure the Sony WF-1000XM4 earbuds are compatible with my Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra.
